initial_description: Stays current with beauty trends; discovery is driven by social media, creators and new launches.

baseline.motivation: Staying current with beauty trends and discovering new products.
characteristics: High trend sensitivity, influencer trust, novelty seeking, and social-media engagement.
Discovers products through TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and beauty creators.
Values viral popularity, social proof, and new launches.
May tolerate higher prices or mixed reviews for highly desirable trending products.

note: Baseline behavioral hypotheses, not validated consumer findings. Research substantiates, challenges and refines them. Income, geography and budget are set per session, never here.
